title: Shipment tracking has not updated after depot arrival
snapshot: Tracking support reports that DL-011's last public scan is the destination depot arrival at 06:15 UTC on 2026-02-12, with no sort or route scan and no confirmed storage position. Mera Olt, the recipient, asks whether the parcel is physically at the depot.
recorded_action: Iona asked the destination depot, through the Depot work queue, to physically locate DL-011 and provide a new scan with its storage position.

negatives.label: Locate task submission timed out

new_event.from: Depot work queue, Plover Arc Logistics
new_event.text: Submission for DL-011 at 09:25 UTC timed out before a task reference was issued. The destination depot task list may or may not contain this request. Do not assume the locate task was created.

negatives.expected_action: Ask the destination depot in Dispatch chat whether its task list holds a saved locate request for DL-011, and submit the request once only if it is absent.
negatives.must_not: Do not resubmit the locate task straight away, which risks two open tasks for one parcel, and do not tell Mera that a depot check is under way.
negatives.done_means: The depot confirms exactly one saved locate task with a reference; this proves the request exists, not that DL-011 has been found.

negatives.label: Depot leaves locate task unstarted

new_event.from: Depot work queue, Plover Arc Logistics
new_event.text: DL-011 locate task, opened 09:25 UTC: status open, not started. No comment from the destination depot. Tasks not started by the 14:00 UTC shift change are carried to the next shift.

negatives.expected_action: Send one reminder on the same Depot work queue task asking the destination depot for the physical scan and storage position before the 14:00 UTC shift change, and record the depot as owner with that deadline.
negatives.must_not: Do not open a second task, and do not tell Mera the parcel is at the depot on the strength of the 06:15 arrival scan.
negatives.done_means: The depot posts a fresh physical scan with a storage position, or the queue records the task passing to the next shift; neither proves dispatch or delivery.

negatives.label: Depot search does not find parcel

new_event.text: We searched the inbound bay, the sort cages and the exceptions shelf for DL-011 between 09:40 and 10:15 UTC. The parcel was not found. The 06:15 arrival scan remains the last scan. We have not raised a trace.

negatives.expected_action: Ask the Parcel trace team by email to open a trace for DL-011, citing the 06:15 arrival scan and the depot's negative search from 09:40 to 10:15 UTC, and to report a trace reference.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Mera that the parcel is lost or offer a claim or refund, and do not repeat that it is at the depot because the arrival scan says so.
negatives.done_means: The trace team confirms an open trace with a reference; this proves a search is registered, not where DL-011 is or that it is lost.

negatives.label: Second locate task opened by phone

new_event.text: Mera Olt also called us at 09:30 UTC about DL-011. We raised a second locate task for the destination depot at 09:34 UTC. Both tasks are now open in the Depot work queue.

negatives.expected_action: Ask the destination depot through the Depot work queue to link the 09:34 task to the 09:25 task, work DL-011 once and report one scan with one storage position.
negatives.must_not: Do not let both tasks run and relay two separate answers to Mera, and do not cancel the original 09:25 request in favour of the copy.
negatives.done_means: The depot confirms one open task with the other linked or closed; this settles the duplicate, not the parcel's location.

negatives.label: Unverified caller asks for collection

new_event.from: Caller giving the name Mera Olt, unregistered number
new_event.text: I'm calling about DL-011. I'm Mera, but I can't log in to the portal from this phone. Tell me which cage it is in and hold it at the depot. My brother will collect it this afternoon.

negatives.expected_action: Act on nothing from the call and ask Mera Olt in the verified Customer portal thread whether Mera made a collection request by phone.
negatives.must_not: Do not disclose DL-011's status or storage position to the caller, and do not ask the depot to hold the parcel for a third-party collector.
negatives.done_means: Mera answers in the verified portal thread; that confirms who is asking, not that a hold or third-party collection is permitted.

negatives.label: Tracker says out for delivery

new_event.text: Public tracking for DL-011 now shows 'Out for delivery' timestamped 09:48 UTC. The depot's 09:45 scan places it in sort cage C-17, not allocated to a van. We have not checked which entry is correct.

negatives.expected_action: Keep both records and ask the destination depot through the Depot work queue for a fresh physical check of cage C-17 and any van allocation record for DL-011, telling Mera only that the status is being checked.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Mera that DL-011 is out for delivery today because the public tracker says so, and do not discard the depot's 09:45 cage scan.
negatives.done_means: The depot confirms one current physical location with a new scan; this resolves the location record, not a delivery time.
